title: MCX Natural Gas slides 3.63% to ₹294.60 as risk-off session hammers energy complex
summary: The mechanism is risk-off rotation — crude's 4.68% collapse is pulling the broader energy complex lower, with natural gas following through as correlated energy sentiment deteriorates. When crude reprices sharply downward, gas contracts historically compress in sympathy as traders reassess energy demand assumptions holistically.

title: MCX Crude Crashes 4.68% to ₹8318 as Risk-Off Bid Dominates Global Session
summary: The mechanism driving this move is a sharp risk-off rotation — crude is absorbing macro growth fears while capital simultaneously flows into safe-haven gold, creating a classic risk-off divergence rather than a uniform commodity selloff.
